invariants.name: price_non_negative
invariants.description: Product price must never be negative
invariants.rule: When creating or updating a product, price >= 0

invariants.name: status_transition_allowed
invariants.description: Status changes must follow allowed transitions
invariants.rule: active -> inactive, discontinued; inactive -> active, discontinued; discontinued -> (none)

invariants.name: archived_entity_not_mutable
invariants.rule: If product.status === 'discontinued', reject all PATCH operations
